::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 70,198 people lived in County Sligo, up 7.1% on 2016. It had the 22nd largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 39% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Sligo was €1,156, the 18th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
